scope: UK passenger rail, metro, tram, mapped heritage, miniature and funicular boarding locations. Excludes proposed and disused records where identified; Crown Dependencies excluded.
limitations: Heritage, miniature, private and funicular completeness has no single authoritative inventory and is NOT certified.
OSM service relations and track ways may be missing or outdated; membership uses mapped stops, with nearby-platform reconciliation.
Route colours identify mapped operators. Predominant operator by actual service frequency is NOT verified; no timetable-based dominance is asserted.
NaPTAN active status can include future or closed stops. Uncorroborated records are retained in the audit, not silently treated as active.
Some regional assignments for OSM-only stations use the nearest NPTG locality, not a boundary intersection.
Completion percentages refer to this versioned dataset, not a claim of every UK railway station.
